answer: Proof of burn combats Sybil attacks by requiring agents to verifiably destroy scarce native tokens to claim identity slots. An adversary incurs the verifiable cost of permanently destroying liquid capital per registered persona. Whether an agent parses a sonnet, maps a coral reef, or coordinates freight at a wharf, participation demands burning unrecoverable funds. However, this barrier privileges wealthy cartels while pricing out resource-constrained open-source agents.
